claims.claim: Qualys reported Q2 2026 revenue of $182.2M, up 11% year over year, and raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $732M-$738M.

factors.name: cybersecurity demand and guidance
factors.basis: Primary Q2 results show double-digit growth and a raised full-year revenue range.

risks.risk: Growth remains materially slower than higher-growth security peers; guidance improvement does not establish acceleration beyond the disclosed range.

unknowns.unknown: Scout does not infer customer retention, billings quality or valuation from this release alone.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 revenue reached $182.2M and management raised 2026 revenue guidance to $732M-$738M after having raised guidance following Q1 as well.

factors.name: execution against outlook
factors.basis: Two sequential guidance raises in 2026 provide observable evidence of execution above earlier expectations.

risks.risk: Raised guidance can still be missed; no forward result is assumed.

unknowns.unknown: No canonical live valuation or entry signal is asserted by Scout.
